$comment: Per-stage presets the worker copies into stage.json: gate checks, write scope, default caps, skills to use, default task. Keys are stage ids. gateFirst: run the gate before any model session on the first attempt and skip the session when it already passes.

gdd.task: Write game/design/gdd.md from game/design/concept.md with the gdd-author skill; style.json may be adjusted within the schema.

systems.task: Select and parameterise catalog systems in game/design/systems.json so every GDD verb and feedback event is covered; then write the content those systems read that the idea decides (a farm's crops, content/crops.json), held to the rules they set.

composition.task: A freeform game only: name the game's entities (content/entities.json) from the shipped ones, write its win and lose rules (content/objectives.json) when the objectives system is selected, and the content its systems read that the idea decides (a farm's crops, content/crops.json).

scaffold.task: Scaffold the game package from the design artifacts (worker step).

behaviour.task: Author one BehaviourFsm per enemy type in the GDD scope using the genre vocabulary.

implement.task: Implement any mechanic the GDD requires that no selected catalog system provides, as bespoke GlueTS systems under game/src/systems with unit tests. If every GDD mechanic is already covered, append one line to game/design/deviations.md saying so and stop.

prove.task: A freeform game only: record a winning run for every level again after a change to how the game plays (worker step); a level no one can win fails the stage.

levels.task: Produce the GDD's level count as data with a monotonic difficulty ramp; every level must pass the validator and the solver bot.

integrate.task: Check that every asset request has a placeholder in game/assets/manifest.json and that the build boots. Phase 1 games are code-drawn: do not add binary assets.

playtest.task: Run the playtest skill on seeds 1, 2 and 3, triage the report and fix small issues within the write scope. Do not redesign.

juice.task: Make every GDD feedback event produce its channels at runtime (juice-pass skill); tune only within the clamps.

review.task: Ask the gdd-reviewer subagent for a fresh-context review; write its findings to game/reports/review.json as {"findings":[{"severity":"P0|P1","file":"...","note":"..."}]}; fix every P0 within the write scope.

smoke.task: Full gate over an existing game (demo and regression).

apply-params.task: Apply a parameter patch to design/systems.json within catalog ranges; regenerate levels when the impact says so (worker step).

apply-style.task: Apply a style patch to design/style.json (worker step).

apply-content.task: Write the authored levels into content/levels once the genre validator and the solver bot accept each one (worker step).
